title: Compliance Desk Q&A: Document Check Charge on a Vehicle Change, Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Q. When does a change of vehicle on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement carry a document check charge?**

A document check charge is added where the insurance on file for the vehicle being replaced expires no more than 30 days after the handling date (the near-expiry charge, **$8.00**) or more than 30 days but no more than 60 days after it (the far-expiry charge, **$4.00**); nothing is added when it expires later.

**Q. Which insurance date is read?** The insurance expiry date on file for the vehicle being replaced — the one on file before the change — not the new vehicle's card.

**Q. What if that insurance has already expired?** An expiry date already passed is no more than 30 days after the handling date: $8.00.

**Q. Where does the charge go?** It is added after the swap fee level has been multiplied by anything it is multiplied by; the fee is rounded to the cent at the end.

**Q. Hypothetical cases (handling date 1 June)?**

| Insurance on file for the vehicle being replaced expires | Days after 1 June | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| 1 July | 30 | $8.00 |
| 2 July | 31 | $4.00 |
| 31 July | 60 | $4.00 |
| 1 August | 61 | nothing |
| 15 May | already passed | $8.00 |
